Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied image, the latest approved three-headed six-armed Asura outline drawing for a game meridian atlas.
PRIMARY CHANGE: replace most of the cloth strips, arm wrappings and floating fabric ribbons with ornaments appropriate to a powerful Asura. Preserve absolutely the current THREE heads with distinct expressions and angles, SIX arms and their distinct poses, SIX correctly handed hands (especially the upper image-left open palm whose thumb points IMAGE-LEFT), central muscular anatomy, stance, feet positions and portrait registration. Keep exactly 1122 x 1402 canvas if possible.

Specific costume replacement:
- Remove the floating ribbons behind and between all six arms, and remove cloth wrapped along the forearms and wrists. Leave clear negative space around every elbow, wrist and hand so their anatomy reads immediately.
- Replace the arm cloth with restrained rigid metal armlets at the upper arms and ONE well-defined bracelet or short cuff on each wrist. Armlets and cuffs should conform to cylinder perspective and shorten on the far side. Use strong simple Asura ornament shapes: thick circular bangles, angular engraved rims, a small pointed lotus or flame contour motif. No protruding spikes near fingers. Do not add chains or ribbons that can be confused with fingers.
- Replace the big cloth waist knot with a broad simple segmented metal waist girdle and a small central fierce-mask clasp, two short decorative pendants. Keep anatomy of chest and abdomen uncovered and visually clear for meridian nodes.
- Reduce the extremely large flowing draperies around legs to a SHORT, SIMPLE opaque-looking-in-contour loincloth / battle skirt covering the pelvis and upper thighs, a few broad folds only; preserve existing knees, lower legs, feet and their exact pose. No exposed genitals. Remove long trailing fabric tails.
- Replace ankle fabric bindings with solid simple anklets, keep feet bare and recognizable.
- Optional small simple ear rings on the rear heads where visible. Avoid cluttering faces or changing hair.

This is still only sparse clean MONOCHROME OUTLINE ART, NOT a colored costume illustration. Metal is indicated by shape and a few engraved contour lines only, no gray fill, no hatching, no metallic shading, no shine, no gradients, no color. Preserve transparent interiors of the illustration as in the reference, all spaces between line strokes fully transparent, genuine alpha background. All six hands and all fingers distinct and unobstructed, exactly three left hands and three right hands. Keep line weight consistent with the original. No weapons, full armor, extra arms, background, text, labels, node symbols or watermark.
